name: Bludgeon Brawl — noncreature non-Equipment artifacts become Equipment
notes: Memory: project_bludgeon_brawl_fix_2026-04-08. The comma in 'noncreature, non-Equipment' dropped a qualifier and the trailing equip clause aborted the parse.
